articles.summary: Selma Blair, a renowned 49-year-old actor known for her roles in movies like “Cruel Intentions,” “Legally Blonde,” and “Hellboy,” announced that she is in remission from Multiple Sclerosis (MS). Diagnosed with the disease in 2018, Blair shared her positive prognosis during a panel at the Television Critics Association.
articles.title: How to Make Stem-Cell Therapy work for MS: Selma Blair's Triumph
